title: Paper Tour document model
description: Output of ingest/ingest.py. Every element the tour can point at has a stable ID and exact PDF coordinates. Coordinates are PDF points, origin at the top-left of the page, y growing downward (PyMuPDF convention). A bbox is [x0, y0, x1, y1].

file.description: PDF file name, relative to the doc.json folder.

generator.description: Tool and version that produced this file.

sections.description: Document outline in reading order. Targeting a section points at its heading block.

number.description: Printed number such as "3.2"; absent for Abstract, References, etc.

type.description: figure_text and table_text are text inside a figure or table region; they carry no sentences.

sentences.description: Sentences in reading order. A sentence never spans blocks; one that continues across a column or page break is split into two entries.

rects.description: One rect per line fragment, so a highlight hugs the text instead of covering the whole block.

figures.description: Figures and tables, identified by their printed number.

bbox.description: The graphic or table body, excluding the caption.

image.description: PNG crop of bbox, relative to the doc.json folder.

panels.description: Sub-figures in reading order (left to right, top to bottom). May be empty.

bbox.description: Page coordinates, inside the parent figure's bbox.

label.description: Printed label such as "(a)" if one was found.

referenced_by.description: Sentences that cite this figure or table, e.g. "as shown in Figure 2".

equations.description: Numbered display equations. Best effort; may be empty.

text.description: Extracted text; math is usually garbled, so treat it as a hint only.

exercises.description: Tasks of an exercise sheet ("Aufgabe 1 (4 Punkte)", "Exercise 2 [6 points]") in reading order, with their parts. Present only when the document has tasks. A task or part ID points at all of its blocks.

title.description: Printed title such as "Lineare Gleichungssysteme", if the heading has one.

points.description: Points stated in the heading; "2+3 Punkte" is 5.

block.description: The block that starts with the heading. A heading on a line of its own is a block of its own; one that runs into the statement ("Aufgabe 3 (5 Punkte) Sei V ...") shares its block with the statement's first lines.

blocks.description: Every block of the task in reading order, from the heading block to the end of its last part, across pages.

parts.description: Parts in order: "a)", "(b)", or "(i)" when the task numbers its parts in roman numerals. May be empty.

exerciseId.description: "ex" and the printed number: ex1, ex2.3, exH1, exIV; a number printed twice gets a suffix, ex1-2.

exercisePartId.description: The task's ID and the part's label: ex1.a, or ex1.c.ii for a sub-part.

label.description: The printed label without brackets: "a" for "(a)" and "a)", "ii" for "(ii)".

page.description: Page of the part's first block.

blocks.description: Blocks of the part in reading order, starting with the one that holds its label; includes the blocks of its sub-parts.

parts.description: Sub-parts such as (i) and (ii) under (c). Absent when there are none.
